name: The Commons at Rivery
summary: The Commons at Rivery is a fourteen-acre multi-use development located at the gateway of Georgetown, Texas, developed by Partners Real Estate and Novak Commercial. This modern open-air center serves the rapidly growing Georgetown market with a mix of retail, dining, and service tenants.
demographics: The Commons at Rivery serves the rapidly growing Georgetown, Texas market, attracting affluent families and young professionals drawn to the area's strong economy and quality of life. The trade area encompasses both established Georgetown residents and newcomers to the master-planned Rivery community, with household incomes skewing above the regional average. Primary shoppers include dual-income families aged 30-55 seeking convenient access to everyday retail, dining, and services in a modern open-air setting.
description: The Commons at Rivery represents a premier fourteen-acre multi-use development strategically positioned at the gateway of Georgetown, Texas, along Williams Drive between Park Lane and Rivery Boulevard. Developed through a partnership between Partners Real Estate and Novak Commercial, this modern shopping destination serves the thriving Georgetown community with a carefully curated mix of retail, dining, and service offerings. The center's location capitalizes on Georgetown's rapid growth as one of the fastest-growing cities in Texas, benefiting from its proximity to Austin while maintaining its own distinct character and charm. Designed as an open-air community gathering place, The Commons at Rivery provides residents and visitors with convenient access to quality shopping and dining experiences in a contemporary setting. The development continues to evolve with new tenants joining this dynamic retail destination that serves as a cornerstone of the expanding Rivery master-planned community.
